title: Annabel Croft's daughter Lily Coleman marries Felix McCorquodale, relative of Princess Diana, in London
summary_full: Annabel Croft's daughter Lily Coleman married insurance executive Felix McCorquodale at St Mary's Church in Battersea, London. The bride stunned in two wedding dresses, while her husband has a family connection to Princess Diana through her stepmother, Raine McCorquodale. The wedding brought together family and friends for an emotional celebration filled with flowers, music and dancing.
